instruction: On the Desktop, use the requirements document to guide you in resizing an image to 160x255 pixels, then save it as 'pic.jpg' back onto the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing the image to 160x255 pixels (50% of original 320x510). The evaluator checks if the saved image has exactly these dimensions using a custom getter that reads the image dimensions.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts image dimensions from the saved file at /home/user/Desktop/pic.jpg using PIL
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('width') and expected.get('height')
Metric correctly compares both width AND height against expected values (160x255 pixels)
Complete coverage: verifies both requirements (correct dimensions 160x255 AND correct file path/name pic.jpg)
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns {width, height} -> metric compares both dimensions
Edge cases handled: returns {width: 0, height: 0} if file doesn't exist, metric returns 0.0 for null/empty inputs
Expected values are correct: 160x255 pixels exactly matches instruction requirements
No postconfig needed: file persists after task completion, getter can directly read it
